import re,json,html
t=open('/workspace/products/research/apify-ppe-docs.html',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>',' ',t,flags=re.S)
s=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s))
s=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s)
out=[]
for kw in ['80%','20%','profit','revenue','platform usage','costs','memory','start','Actor start','free tier','x402','minimum']:
  for m in list(re.finditer(re.escape(kw),s))[:4]:
    out.append({'kw':kw,'snip':s[max(0,m.start()-220):m.end()+220]})
open('/workspace/products/research/apify-ppe-extract.json','w').write(json.dumps({'source':'https://docs.apify.com/platform/actors/publishing/monetize/pay-per-event','text_len':len(s),'snippets':out},indent=1))
print(len(s),len(out))
